resources.string: Select the payment and banking apps you want Kharch to monitor for transaction alerts:
Android grants access to all notifications at the OS level. This app immediately discards anything outside your selected list above — nothing outside it is stored or transmitted.
Android device manufacturers frequently terminate background notification listeners. To ensure continuous operation, exempt Kharch from aggressive battery management.
Disables notification listener, opens OS settings to revoke access, and deletes companion data from the backend.
